name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Build an Ising chain of 10 spins with co
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Build an Ising chain of 10 spins with couplings J=1.37 (ferromagnetic, h=0 except h_0=-0.63) in dimod, sample with SimulatedAnnealingSampler, and verify the ground state is fully aligned against the field on spin 0. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
